findings.description: The doc says in the present tense that `.claude/rules/shell-conventions.md` "loads this file on every request", but that rule doesn't exist yet and AGENTS.md's conventions table has no Shell row. Also, every existing rule is path-scoped (`paths:`), so "every request" only holds if the follow-up rule leaves out `paths:`. Word it as intent ("is meant to load unconditionally") or land the rule with the doc.

In `out=$(cmd 2>&1) && echo ok || { echo "$out" | tail -n 40; }`, the `||` branch ends with `tail`, which exits 0. A failing `cmd` therefore reports success to the harness, and failure hooks don't fire. Add `; false` inside the braces to keep the non-zero exit.
"6154 Bash results under 1k tokens, one for 64% of the 9664 requests" is hard to parse. "6154 Bash results under 1k tokens (64% of the 9664 requests) carried 109.6M tokens" says it plainly.
